items.text_en: Spread sheets on the ground under the tree.
items.text_hr: Razastri plahte po tlu pod stablom.

items.text_en: Comb the branches with a handheld harvester. The olives fall onto the sheets.
items.text_hr: Počešljaj grane ručnim otresačem. Masline padaju na plahte.

items.text_en: Gather the sheets to the middle and bag the fruit.
items.text_hr: Skupi plahte prema sredini i vreći plod.

items.text_en: Press the same day. Olives left overnight begin to ferment and the oil loses grade.
items.text_hr: Tiješti isti dan. Masline ostavljene preko noći počnu fermentirati i ulje gubi kakvoću.

items.text_en: Store in stainless steel, in the dark, indoors.
items.text_hr: Čuvaj u nehrđajućem čeliku, u mraku, u zatvorenom.

items.text_en: Prune the following day, every second year. The prunings dry for a year and then burn as firewood.
items.text_hr: Sutradan reži, svake druge godine. Rezano drvo se suši godinu dana pa gori kao ogrjev.
